notes.title: Malazard 1.1 hotfix released
notes.content:
The following issues have been addressed with this update.
 
    The main menu buttons can be pressed again for those, who updated the Early Access version to 1.0.
    The red screen effect should not get stuck after finishing a level.

notes.title: Malazard is out from Early Access!
notes.content:
Malazard: The Master of Magic has just came out from Early Access.
Based on players' feedback, we added some new features, and implemented various quality-of life improvements. We also fine tuned the visuals to match with our initial goal.

Release notes

Players can now bring their unlocked spells to the previous levels.
Endless survivor mode added.
Leaderboards added for every level and also for the endless mode.
Added Steam achievements.
Added an option to turn off the in-game music.
Added a clarification UI representing the spells relative strength.
New screen effect indicates if the player is on low health.
The intensity of the player hit effect is now based on the amount of damage received.
Toned down the colors so they are not as obstructive as before.
Fixed a bug where the bow spell would erroneously deal the wrong amount of damage.
